corrections_applied.issue: Supervisory gating defect: supervisor prompt merely asked the model to generate a completed schema without anchoring it to an unevaluated supervisory gate schema template, and lacked structural initialization with null values for evaluative/result fields.
corrections_applied.change: Implemented buildUnevaluatedSupervisoryGate(step, executionReturn) which extracts the exact supervisory_gate schema defined in Agents.md for each step and constructs an unpopulated, unevaluated template with all evaluative values initialized to null (granular terminal evaluations, comments, step_level_evaluation, failures list, and gate_result). The controller passes this unevaluated template along with the execution return to the supervisor semantic operator so the supervisor fills it out from neutral null states. In normalizedGateValue, the controller validates that gate_result is non-null and strictly PASS or FAIL before evaluating advancement.
corrections_applied.agents_md_basis: Agents.md Supervisory Gate specifications for Step 0 (lines 132-180), Step 1 (lines 192-240), Step 2 (lines 254-302), Step 3 (lines 761-813), and Step 4 (lines 951-999).

corrections_applied.issue: Step 3 supervisory gate template requires evaluation_documents_read acknowledgment initialized to null prior to evaluation.
corrections_applied.change: For Step 3 supervisory gate, included evaluation_documents_read initialized to null in the unevaluated schema template, requiring the supervisor to record completion alongside granular and step-level evaluations.

corrections_applied.issue: Supervisor repair instructions previously prompted with 'with value PASS or FAIL' leading to potential bias or premature completion without filling granular mirror.
corrections_applied.change: Revised supervisor prompt and repair branches to instruct the model to populate the provided unevaluated template completely, replacing null placeholders with objective evaluations and comments based strictly on the execution return.
corrections_applied.agents_md_basis: Agents.md Supervisory Gate instructions: 'Recursively mirror every returned key and every array entry at the same schema path. For every terminal returned value, replace the execution value with an evaluation and supervisor comment. Evaluate the step as a whole after completing the granular mirror. Every failed granular or step-level evaluation must be entered separately in failures. The next execution step is permitted only when gate_result is PASS.'
